newsitem.title: GREECE: BAHAROPOULOS IS MAC-THRACE BANK'S GENERAL MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: BAHAROPOULOS IS MAC-THRACE BANK'S GENERAL MANAGER.

text.p: The board of directors of state Macedonia-Thrace Bank picked Eleftherios Baharopoulos, treasurer at private Bank of Piraeus since May 1992, to be its new general manager, the bank said in a statement.
He is to resign his post at Bank of Piraeus on August 1, bank sources told Reuters.
Baharopoulos who holds an MA on international business relations from Boston's Tufts university headed the Bank of Greece's forex department before joining the Bank of Piraeus.

The move is part of Macedonian-Thrace Bank's strategy, devised by its president Spyros Kouniakis, to modernise and strengthen its position in the Greek banking sector, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
